summary: With a managed database, restore from a temporary `registry.redhat.io/rhel8/postgresql-15:latest` container run on the database node with host networking, the `~/aap/tls/extracted` CA trust and `~/aap/postgresql/server.crt`/`.key` mounted, and `~/artifact` mounted read-only at `/var/lib/pgsql/backups`; check images with `podman images ls` if it's missing.
questions: How do I restore databases into containerized AAP?
Which image do I use for the migration restore container?

answer_card.title: Temporary restore container
answer_card.answer_md:
On the database node:
```bash
podman run -it --rm --name postgresql_restore_temp --network host \
  --volume ~/aap/tls/extracted:/etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted:z \
  --volume ~/aap/postgresql/server.crt:/var/lib/pgsql/server.crt:ro,z \
  --volume ~/aap/postgresql/server.key:/var/lib/pgsql/server.key:ro,z \
  --volume ~/artifact:/var/lib/pgsql/backups:ro,z \
  registry.redhat.io/rhel8/postgresql-15:latest bash
```
